reviews.text:
2) SKIN1004 Centella Ampoule Foam — Review
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5
Such a gentle but effective cleanser! It foams nicely, cleans the skin well and removes sunscreen without making my face feel tight or dry. My skin feels soft and calm after washing, and it’s great even for sensitive areas. The formula feels soothing and not irritating at all. A little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts long.
Best for: everyday morning & evening cleanse ✅
reviews.zh:
2) SKIN1004 Centella Ampoule Foam — 評價
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5
超溫和但又有效嘅潔面產品！起泡效果好靚，可以清得好乾淨又卸到防曬，唔會令我塊面繃緊或者乾燥。洗完之後皮膚感覺柔軟同舒緩，就連敏感位置用都好好。配方感覺好舒緩，完全唔刺激。少少已經好夠用，所以樽裝都好襟用。
最適合：每日早晚清潔 ✅

reviews.text:
The Perfect pH-Balanced Finish for Double Cleansing
​"If the cleansing oil is the 'heavy duty' solvent for sunscreen and sebum, then this Centella Ampoule Foam is the precision finish. As an engineer who monitors my skin’s condition closely, I know that the biggest risk with foam cleansers is stripping the moisture barrier (that 'squeaky clean' feeling is actually bad news). This product, however, strikes the perfect balance between cleaning power and hydration.
​
reviews.zh:
雙重清潔嘅完美 pH 平衡收尾
「如果卸妝油係對付防曬同皮脂嘅『重型』溶劑，咁呢隻 Centella Ampoule Foam 就係精準嘅收尾。作為一個工程師，我會密切留意自己皮膚嘅狀況，我知泡沫潔面最大嘅風險係會洗走保護屏障（嗰種『squeaky clean』嘅感覺其實係壞消息）。不過呢隻產品喺清潔力同保濕之間取得咗完美嘅平衡。」

reviews.text: Unfortunately, this cleanser did not work for me. I’m not sure what changed, because I had bought this exact same cleanser before and loved it! The first time I bought it, it cleansed my skin well and wasn’t irritating. This time, it REALLY irritated my skin and caused it to sting!😭🥺 I was so surprised because it had never done that previously. So, I’m not sure if they added some exfoliants to the formulation or something, but I’ve used my tube of it about 3 times and its just been sitting in my shower since😢🙂‍↕️ It was really a disappointment. It also seemed way more drying this time as well. I can’t say that I recommend it anymore, regrettably.
reviews.zh: 可惜，呢隻潔面產品唔啱我用。我唔知有咩唔同咗，因為我之前買過同一隻潔面，當時超鍾意！第一次買嘅時候，佢可以清得好乾淨又唔刺激。但今次用真係嚴重刺激到我塊面，搞到我塊面好刺痛！😭🥺 因為之前從來都冇試過咁，所以好驚訝。所以我唔知係咪佢哋加入咗某啲去角質成分或者類似嘅嘢，但我用咗大概 3 次之後，支嘢就一直擺喺浴室入面😢🙂‍↕️ 真係好失望。今次用感覺亦都更加乾燥。遺憾地我已經冇辦法再推薦呢隻產品。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Double Cleansing Duo
reviews.text:
First thing that I noticed when I’ve got this products I noticed that the ampoule foam soap looks like it had some product missing. The whole bottle wasn’t filled to the brim so I was a bit disappointed.
Besides that the oil cleansing one was very good took off my make up great, but not as good as I was hoping it had some hard time to take off my mascara and my eyebrow gel, but it indeed got off my face a bit of blackheads and dry skin
The other product, the foam one did a great job of rinsing after the rest of the oil butt it leaves the skin with a little bit of dry feeling
reviews.zh:
我收到呢啲產品嘅時候，第一時間留意到 ampoule foam 潔面好似唔夠料，成支都冇裝滿，所以有少少失望。
除咗呢點之外，卸妝油嗰支好好用，可以好有效咁卸走妝容，但就冇去到我想像中咁好，卸我嘅睫毛液同眉 gel 有啲吃力，但確實可以幫我清走少少黑頭同死皮。
另一支泡沫潔面喺卸妝油之後冲洗得幾乾淨，但用完之後皮膚會有少少乾燥感。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Double Cleansing Duo
reviews.text: I purchased a mini travel kit of Skin1004 Centella range in the UK back in September pre going on vacation as my skin was red, aggravated and acne prone. I have combination sensitive skin, but noticed a difference within days of using the oil cleanser/foam/toner/ampoule and soothing cream. It really has been soft, gentle and just really soothing for my skin after trying so many products. Once I ran out of my minis I ordered the large sizes because I just felt way more confident in my skin after using it. Picture attached show my skin pre, 4 days post and 1 month after using these products. I particularly love the double cleansing as it gently exfoliates away my dry skin and leaves me feeling soft and bright without it being harsh and leaving me feeling stripped.. 5*
reviews.zh: 我 9 月喺英國買咗一套 Skin1004 Centella 系列嘅旅行裝，係去旅行之前買嘅，因為當時我塊面泛紅、又受刺激同容易爆瘡。我係混合性敏感肌，但用咗卸妝油／泡沫潔面／爽膚水／ampoule／舒緩 cream 幾日之後已經見到分別。試過咁多產品之後，呢套真係好柔軟、好溫和，皮膚感覺好舒緩。旅行裝用完之後我即刻去訂咗大裝，因為用完之後我對自己嘅皮膚重拾返信心。附上嘅圖片係用呢啲產品之前、用後 4 日同 1 個月嘅皮膚狀態。我特別鍾意雙重清潔，佢可以溫和咁帶走我嘅死皮，令皮膚感覺柔軟明亮，但完全唔會太刺激或者覺得被洗走晒所有保護⋯⋯ 5*

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I was not sure about cleansing oils because I’ve seen that many people’s skin breakout, and I read all the reviews and they said this is one of the most gentle oil cleansers and I decided to try it. I have combination skin and did not breakout at all. The only thing is that I only use it once a week when I do my “heavy” makeup and it takes all the dirt from your skin. I wash it off with warm water and it helps better to wash away all the product. After using it the skin felt so soft, and of course after that I used a water base face cleanser and the best combo.
reviews.zh: 我本來對卸妝油有啲保留，因為見過好多人用完都爆瘡，我睇晒所有評論，佢哋都話呢隻係最溫和嘅卸妝油之一，所以我就決定試吓。我係混合性肌膚，完全冇爆瘡。唯一係我每個禮拜只會用一次，就係化「heavy」妝嘅時候用，可以帶走皮膚上所有污垢。我會用暖水沖走，咁樣可以更有效咁洗走所有 product。用完之後皮膚感覺超柔軟，跟住當然再用返一款水 base 嘅潔面，呢個配搭真係最夾。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text:

The heavy, greasy formula clogs my pores and exacerbates my blemishes, leading to even more frustrating flare-ups. reviews.zh:
作為一個容易爆瘡嘅肌膚，要搵到一款啱用嘅潔面產品係一件好艱難嘅事。大部分潔面產品都會太刺激、太強效，搞到皮膚繃緊又唔舒服。呢一款油性潔面對我嚟講更加係皮膚嘅大噩夢。

雖然佢聲稱溫和又有滋潤效果，但呢隻潔面產品其實令我爆咗好多瘡。厚重、油笠嘅配方會塞住我嘅毛孔，令我嘅痘痘更加嚴重，導致更多令人沮喪嘅爆發。本以為會係一次舒緩、保濕嘅體驗，結果反而令皮膚覺得毛孔堵塞又受刺激。

我發現無論呢隻潔面點樣好似吸收得好快都好，佢都會留低一層油笠笠嘅殘留物，搞到我塊面覺得沉重又污糟。黐立立嘅質感係我呢啲已經出晒事嘅皮膚最唔需要嘅嘢。完全唔係清爽嘅感覺，反而我嘅膚色 lo

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
I have been using the entire Madagascar Centella line for over a month now and I can confidently say that it has changed my skin for the better. My skin’s texture is smoother, brighter and I no longer get those painful cystic acne, sometimes 1 hormonal pimple a month during my period which is manageable.

1. I double cleanse using the oil cleanser and then the ampoule foam cleanser
2. Toner
3. Ampoule 
4. Soothing cream
5. Cream
6. Sun cream (during the day)

Same routine for night time except sun cream.
reviews.zh:
我已經用咗成個 Madagascar Centella 系列超過一個月，我可以好有信心咁講，佢已經令到我嘅皮膚變好咗。我嘅皮膚質地變得更加平滑、明亮，已經冇再嗰啲好痛嘅囊腫式痘痘，最多一個月經期間會生 1 粒生理痘，呢個已經算可以接受。

1. 我會用卸妝油同 ampoule foam 潔面做雙重清潔
2. 爽膚水
3. Ampoule
4. 舒緩 cream
5. Cream
6. 防曬（日頭先用）

夜晚嘅步驟一樣，只係唔用防曬。
